text:
maria: kicking off staged rollout for service-gen v2.8.0 -> rolling to 5% in eu-west1 first. change window 22:00-02:00 UTC. watching latency/errors. @release-coordinator FYI

deploy-bot: Rollout started by maria — roll-id roll-2634567890. Target: 5% traffic to v2.8.0 in eu-west1.

aj: grabbing baselines now, dashboard https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/abcd123/service-gen. p50=120ms, p95=320ms, errors=0.12%

vikram: seeing p95 bump on canary +60ms vs baseline, but error rate unchanged. holding an extra 3m to observe.

olivia: logs show one pod restarted once with OOMKilled. stacktrace points at batch-aggregation. suspect batch_by_tokens default too high for this image.

ken: hold the percent increase for now. don’t push to 25%. rollback plan staged if errors cross 0.5% or pod restarts >3 in 5m. @sre-bot please apply hold and notify oncall. :rotating_light:

sre-bot: Hold requested by ken. Autoscaling burst temporarily disabled. Routing freeze applied at 5%. Investigator: vikram. Oncall ping: @aj.

aj: oncall here — will try bumping memory limit on canary and re-run with smaller batch. if stable in 2m, propose proceed to 10%.

maria: decision: patch image to v2.8.1 (reduce batch_by_tokens 512->256, bump mem request). redeploying 2 affected canary pods now. putting further rollout steps on pause until patch lands.

deploy-bot: Cancelling scheduled percent increases for roll-2634567890. Deploying image v2.8.1 to canary pods in eu-west1. ETA ~2m.

olivia: will monitor kvcache misses, memory, and tail latency. tagging logs and adding temporary alert for pod restarts.

aj: green at 2634567918 — replaced pods stable, p95 back to baseline, errors cleared. recommend resuming to 20% after a 5m stable window. :thumbsup:

maria: resuming rollout to 20% now. @release-coordinator please note "canary held, hotfix v2.8.1 applied during rollout" in the release notes.

release-coordinator: noted. drafting release notes and a short postmortem blurb for the change log. will flag as minor hotfix and capture timeline.

ken: closing hold. plan: continue to 50% tomorrow morning during the second change window if overnight metrics stay green. great coordination, team.
